claim: The Athenian tetradrachm showed an owl on its reverse.
source: Athenian tetradrachms bore the head of Athena on the obverse and her owl on the reverse.

claim: The Penny Black was the first adhesive postage stamp.
source: The 1840 Penny Black was the world's first adhesive postage stamp, issued in Britain.

claim: Centering grades compare the margins on opposite sides of a stamp.
source: Stamp centering is graded by comparing the margins on opposite sides; a perfectly centered stamp is called gem or superb.

claim: CTO stamps never actually carried mail.
source: CTO (cancelled to order) stamps are cancelled by the postal authority before sale and never actually carried mail.

claim: The Athenian tetradrachm showed a turtle on its reverse.
source: Athenian tetradrachms bore the head of Athena on the obverse and her owl on the reverse.

claim: The Penny Black was issued in 1918.
source: The Penny Black was the world's first adhesive postage stamp, issued in Britain in 1840.

claim: On the Inverted Jenny the airplane is printed right-side up.
source: The Inverted Jenny is famous because the airplane at its center was accidentally printed upside down.

claim: A precancel and a CTO are the same thing.
source: A precancel is cancelled before being affixed to genuine mail, unlike a CTO, which never enters the mail.

claim: The Tyre shekel is the coin of the thirty pieces of silver.
source: Shekels of Tyre were struck in silver at roughly 14 grams, bearing the head of Melqart and an eagle.
